# Spotify (6 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /artist | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify artist |
| /track | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify track |
| /album | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify album |
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search Spotify |
| /podcast | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Spotify podcast |
| /podcast/episodes | `id` / `url` | 1 | List a Spotify podcast's episodes |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /artist — 1cr

Returns artist metadata — id, name, followers, genres, and related artists. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Spotify artist ID. (one of: id, url — at least one required)
  - `url`: Spotify artist URL. (one of: id, url — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/artist?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /track — 1cr

Returns track metadata — artists, album info, duration, playability, and sharing details. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Spotify track ID. (one of: id, url — at least one required)
  - `url`: Spotify track URL. (one of: id, url — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/track?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /album — 1cr

Returns album metadata — artists, release date, cover art, copyright info, tracks, and sharing details. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Spotify album ID. (one of: id, url — at least one required)
  - `url`: Spotify album URL. (one of: id, url — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/album?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /search — 1cr

Searches Spotify playlists matching a query. Note (DR-MS-09): the upstream currently returns Playlist results only, not the full track/artist/album/episode/podcast/audiobook mix — treat non-playlist result types as unavailable until this is expanded.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search query.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /podcast — 1cr

Returns podcast metadata. Spotify calls podcasts `shows` internally, so Spotify podcast URLs use `/show/`. Pass either `id` or `url`.

**Parameters**

- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Spotify podcast (show) ID. (one of: id, url — at least one required)
  - `url`: Spotify podcast (show) URL. (one of: id, url — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/podcast?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /podcast/episodes — 1cr

Returns episodes for a Spotify podcast. Pass the `cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page.

**Parameters**

- `cursor` *(optional)*: Cursor returned by the previous response. Omit for page 1.
- `id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `id`: Spotify podcast (show) ID. (one of: id, url — at least one required)
  - `url`: Spotify podcast (show) URL. (one of: id, url — at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/spotify/podcast/episodes?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Spotify endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Find anything by name | `/search` | 1 |
| An artist's profile | `/artist` | 1 |
| One track | `/track` | 1 |
| An album | `/album` | 1 |
| A podcast show | `/podcast` | 1 |
| That show's episode list | `/podcast/episodes` | 1 |

Every endpoint is 1 credit — there is no expensive tier to avoid here, so explore freely.

### What this is actually good for

Two research jobs beyond music itself:

- **Podcast mapping.** `/podcast` + `/podcast/episodes` (2cr total) gives a show's full episode
  list with titles and descriptions — a cheap way to read a competitor's or a guest's content
  cadence and topics without any transcription.
- **Audio-trend crossover.** When a sound is trending on TikTok or Instagram
  (`tiktok/song`, `instagram/search/music`), `/search` here resolves the underlying track and
  artist so you can tell an original release from a platform-native audio.
